Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning disclosure requirements in long-term care settings regarding autopsies.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to disclosure requirements in long-term caresettings regarding autopsies; amending RCW 18.51.009; and adding a newsection to chapter 70.129 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.129 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A longterm care facility shall disclose to potential residents andtheir legal representatives that, in the event of the death of theresident, an autopsy or postmortem may be authorized by a familymember, guardian, or other person or agency according to the order ofpriority established in RCW 68.50.101.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 18.51.009 and 1994 c 214 s 22 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: RCW 70.129.007, 70.129.105, ((and)) 70.129.150 through 70.129.170,and section 1 of this act apply to this chapter and persons regulatedunder this chapter.
